# GrowClinic

> GrowClinic is a healthcare digital-marketing agency that helps doctors, dentists, dermatologists, and clinics grow with data-driven marketing, automation, and proven patient-acquisition strategies. The GrowClinic AI Audit is a conversational 150-second diagnostic that scores a clinic's online presence and delivers a personalised 90-day growth plan.

## AI Audit
- [GrowClinic AI Audit](https://audit.growclinic.io): A ~150-second conversational audit for clinics, hospitals and specialty practices. It analyses the clinic's Google Business Profile, website speed and conversion, paid-ads gaps, social/reels content, and patient-communication automation, then returns a benchmarked report with a personalised 90-day growth roadmap. The full report is delivered to the doctor's WhatsApp after a quick number verification.

## What GrowClinic helps clinics with
- Google My Business & local search visibility — get found by patients searching nearby
- High-converting clinic websites — fast, mobile-first, built to book appointments
- Google Ads & Meta Ads — targeted patient acquisition with conversion tracking
- Social media & short-form reels content — build trust and reach for visual specialties
- WhatsApp automation — instant replies, appointment reminders, no-show recovery, offer broadcasts

## Who it's for
Dentists, dermatologists & aesthetic clinics, hair/IVF/eye/ortho/cardiology/paediatric clinics, multispecialty clinics, and hospitals looking to attract and retain more patients.
